Dialogue_Text: "The yuan-ti stood there. The man was holding his trusted katana. He was ready for everything. He shall never give up: the heavens are on his side!"
"The heart of the clearing was calm, but the tranquility was just about to turn into a battle. The yuan-ti warlord was on his way. He was there to kill the swordsman. For his life. For Shou Lung."
I think I know this tale, my friend! It's a tale of a truly great battle. And a tale of a powerful sword.
I think I know this tale, my friend! It's a tale of a truly great battle. And a tale of a powerful sword—Celestial Fury! The very same one we already have.

This is a tale of a man from Shou Lung, and the love between him and an archon. Some would consider it heartbreaking. If you decide to learn from it, you'll need to pay 3,500 gold pieces. Then, you will take the place of the yuan-ti warlord and face the warrior.
Yes. Let me see how determined that man truly was.
No. I'll pass. At least for now.
Of course. I truly hope you are ready to fight that monstrous fanatic. Now, close your eyes. Let the story take you.
